entries.title: A waiting crewmate orbits the one it waits on
entries.body: When an idle crewmate waits on one other crewmate you can see, it leaves its own path and circles that crewmate. The circle stands at a right angle to the other crewmate's path. In a busier case it keeps its place, and a line points to the crewmate it waits on.

picture.alt: Firstmate in the center, with a working crewmate and a smaller idle crewmate close together on the right

entries.title: Tasks draws a line to the task that has to finish first
entries.body: A quiet line on the left runs from a waiting task to the task it is blocked by. The arrow sits on the task that has to finish first. Resting on a row lights that line.

picture.alt: The Tasks list with two quiet lines in the left margin, both ending in an arrow at Check the connection
